Subject: Data use / no-train requirement for pilot (Mediprime)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for yesterday's demo. Procurement asked me to follow up with the contractual asks we need for the pilot: a clear no-training/no-derivative-usage commitment, tenant ownership of all prompts/responses, and onshore residency for exports (we prefer SFTP to an onshore bucket). Also need a list of subprocessors and confirmation around KMS/HSM key separation.

Can you send a short ops checklist that shows how Redwood implements a no-learn guarantee in production (evidence we can present to our security reviewers)? A high-level SLA for response latency and an exit/export plan are helpful too. We expect to share this with Legal this week.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our timeline is tight.

Thanks,

Subject: internal: DPA redline and evidence items for Mediprime

Team —

I went through Mediprime's initial asks and attached a redline (redline-dpa-llm.pdf) with suggestions. Key items I added:

1) Contractual clauses
- No-training: explicit language that Redwood will not use customer input (prompts, files, transcripts) to train or improve models, including derivative model creation, for the duration of the pilot and any subsequent contracted periods unless customer provides written consent.
- Ownership: confirm customer retains all rights to prompts and generated responses; Redwood grants runtime delivery rights only.
- Subprocessor gating: require prior notice and 10-business-day review for new subprocessors touching tenant data; option for onshore-only subprocessors for this account.

2) Operational evidence (ops pack items)
- Runtime controls doc (Dev): how we implement non-learning mode — details on KV cache, disabled telemetry ingestion pipelines, per-tenant routing to non-adaptive model variants, and ephemeral log retention (7 days by default for the pilot).
- Subprocessor list and SOC2 statements: include versions and data-flows; show which subprocessors have access to plaintext and which only see encrypted artifacts.
- KMS separation: propose onshore KMS for Mediprime keys + HSM-backed wrapping keys; note minimum lead time for rotation and import.

3) Exit/export
- Export format: support SFTP CSV export or SFTP-encrypted tarball of prompts/responses and associated metadata. Provide SHA256 checksums and proof-of-delivery logs.
- Proof-of-deletion: API call logs and confirmation, plus a retention purge report.

I've attached the redline and a template ops checklist. Dev: please fill in the 'Runtime controls' tab of the attached spreadsheet with concrete steps and evidence items you can deliver in 48 hours.

Kimberly Park
Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline-dpa-llm.pdf; no-learn-ops-checklist.xlsx

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Mira Patel <mira.patel@mediprime.com>, Alex Rivers <alex.rivers@mediprime.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Procurement Team <procurement@mediprime.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data use / no-train requirement for pilot (Mediprime)

Mira / Alex —

Following up with the package we discussed. Attached are: (1) DPA redline with explicit no-training and ownership language, (2) ops checklist that maps each contractual claim to operational evidence we can deliver, and (3) an export & exit playbook. High-level summary below: 

- No-train guarantee: Redwood will not use customer data to train or improve models for the pilot. This includes no derivative model creation. Any change requires written consent.
- Runtime safeguards: per-tenant routing to a non-adaptive model variant, disabled telemetry ingestion for Mediprime traffic, ephemeral KV cache retention, and audit logs for every export.
- Subprocessors: complete inventory included. We can gate new subprocessors for Mediprime with a 10-business-day review window; onshore-only subprocessors are possible as an elevation.
- KMS & keys: offer onshore KMS with HSM-backed key wrapping for tenant encryption keys; key import window estimated at 2 weeks.
- Export/exit: SFTP-encrypted tarball (or CSV export) with checksums; proof-of-deletion report and audit logs on completion.

Please confirm:
1) Preferred export format (SFTP CSV or tarball)
2) Legal redline owner and timeline for sign-off
3) Whether Mediprime wants subprocessors restricted to onshore-only for the pilot

If you greenlight, we'll prepare a DocuSign-ready DPA and Ops Evidence bundle. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute security walkthrough for your reviewers this week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline-dpa-llm.pdf; no-learn-ops-checklist.xlsx; export-exit-playbook.pdf
